Microdata package https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3497 (3497.sav variable and value labels; 3497_num.csv); questionnaire https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/cues3497 P.8 [P8DE]; published marginals https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/es3497mar-pdf Pregunta 8. Processing script data/spain_2025_democracy.do (Bookmark 6: efficacy). Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the CIS microdata package md3497.zip (https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3497) ships 3497.sav, whose variable labels tie each column to its statement outright -- P8DE_1 'La gente como yo no tiene ninguna influencia sobre lo que hace el Gobierno', P8DE_2 '...ninguna posibilidad de manifestar su opinion a los/as politicos/as', P8DE_3 'Este quien este en el poder, siempre busca sus intereses personales', P8DE_4 'Los/as politicos/as no se preocupan mucho de lo que piensa la gente como yo' -- and the same .sav's value labels give the anchors (1 Muy de acuerdo, 2 De acuerdo, 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo', 4 En desacuerdo, 5 Muy en desacuerdo, 8 N.S., 9 N.C.). All four strings are character-for-character identical to the questionnaire PDF cues3497.pdf, P.8 block [P8DE]. Derivation is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2025_democracy.do imports 3497_num.csv, does 'rename *, lower', and sets item = the column name, so p8de_1..p8de_4 ARE the source columns -- nothing positional, Step 5b exempt. Checked against the data anyway and decisively (see verify_spain_2025_democracy_efficacy.R): the .do file drops resp in {3,8,9} for this block, and the resulting per-column n in 3497_num.csv are 3979/3983/3967/3956, all four distinct, reproducing the live per-item n exactly via irw_table_sets (no export). text_source=study_materials: Spanish wording transcribed from CIS's own questionnaire and .sav. instructions are the P.8 carrier question including its interviewer instruction, verbatim. translation_source=machine_translation: the English in the four _translated columns was produced by IRW; CIS publishes no English version of this questionnaire. RESP SET: the live table holds 1,2,4,5 -- code 3, the not-read-aloud 'Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' midpoint (0.1-0.7% of respondents per the published marginals), is dropped as a sentinel by the .do file alongside 8/9, so no option row is shipped for it. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Agreement with statements about personal influence over government and politicians' matches the P8DE block; no instrument mismatch. RIGHTS: no block. The wording's originator is CIS itself, a Spanish public body, and its reuse conditions (https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis, sha256 4212cb1a5409480c5771973e992a7b801a8c6ebebd6f5a2a518fa094ca5caa57, fetched 2026-09-20) grant a positive right rather than reserving one: 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales... incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusion, modificacion, adaptacion, extraccion, reordenacion y combinacion de la informacion' and 'Esta autorizacion conlleva, asimismo, la cesion gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual'. The only conditions are attribution ('Origen de los datos: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas'), not distorting the information, not implying CIS endorsement, and preserving metadata -- none of which is a reserved right. No instrument_rights_register.csv row written (a round may not write a ship row). Sibling note: cues3497.pdf covers all eight spain_2025_democracy_* tables (P2/P7/P11 system, P3P parties, P3AP internal, P4JU judiciary, P5ME media, P8DE efficacy, P10GR trust, P12 priorities); only the P8DE block was extracted here.
public_note: The English item, instruction and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish; the administered Spanish is in the base fields. Note also that respondents could volunteer a middle 'Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' answer (CIS code 3, not read aloud, chosen by 0.1-0.7% of the sample) which the IRW processing script treats as missing, so the response values run 1, 2, 4, 5 with no option row for 3.

note: Item codes p3ap_1..p3ap_5 ARE the source column names: data/spain_2025_democracy.do imports the CIS microdata 3497_num.csv and only lowercases headers (rename *, lower), so no positional assignment occurs. The deposit's 3497.sav labels each variable with its full statement (P3AP_1 = 'Que los/as responsables del partido sean elegidos/as por los afiliados/as' ... P3AP_5 = 'Exigir la firma de un codigo etico a todos los cargos organicos y cargos publicos') and labels every value (1 Muy de acuerdo, 2 De acuerdo, 3 (NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo, 4 En desacuerdo, 5 Muy en desacuerdo, 8 N.S., 9 N.C.), so both axes are tied at the source. item_text is transcribed from the questionnaire cues3497.pdf P.3a grid (the administered form); it is identical to the .sav variable labels except for capitalisation ('Defensor del afiliado/a', 'Codigo Etico' in the questionnaire vs lowercase in the .sav and the marginals report). Cross-checked anyway: per-item x per-level counts in 3497_num.csv match irw_fetch exactly in all 20 cells (p3ap_1 873/2015/769/315, p3ap_2 844/2183/665/200, p3ap_3 923/2381/518/80, p3ap_4 1047/2407/321/81, p3ap_5 2778/1113/61/27 for resp 1/2/4/5). resp 3, 8 and 9 are dropped by the .do file, which is why the live resp set is {1,2,4,5} and no option rows exist for them. The published weighted marginals (es3497mar.pdf, Pregunta 3a) differ from these unweighted counts because CIS applies coefficient PESO (FT3497.pdf); the ordering across items is preserved. English in the _translated columns was produced by this project. RIGHTS: CIS is a Spanish public body and its reuse conditions grant, verbatim, 'La reutilizacion autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusion, modificacion, adaptacion, extraccion, reordenacion y combinacion de la informacion' and 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' (https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizacion-datos-cis, fetched 2026-09-20), subject only to source attribution, non-distortion and no claim of official status. That is an affirmative grant, not a reserved right. No instrument_rights_register.csv row was written: a round may never write a ship row (SKILL.md), so this is escalated to the human for a CIS-family row covering all spain_* tables.
public_note: The item and response wording for this CIS survey question is in Spanish, as administered; the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS.

Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/calidad-de-la-democracia-iii-. Processing script data/spain_2025_democracy.do, Bookmark 4.
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the CIS microdata deposit MD3497.zip ships 3497.sav, whose VARIABLE labels tie each source column to its statement verbatim -- P4JU_1 'La justicia trata igual a ricos/as que a pobres', P4JU_2 'La justicia trata igual a un/a politico/a que a un/a ciudadano/a corriente', P4JU_3 'En procesos judiciales que afectan a partidos politicos, la justicia siempre es imparcial', P4JU_4 'Las mujeres tienen las mismas posibilidades de ascender en la carrera judicial que los hombres' -- and whose VALUE labels (labels26-labels29, identical) tie the codes to the anchors 1 'Muy de acuerdo', 2 'De acuerdo', 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo', 4 'En desacuerdo', 5 'Muy en desacuerdo', 8 'N.S.', 9 'N.C.'. All four strings are identical character for character to the [P4JU] grid on page 4 of the questionnaire cues3497.pdf, in the same order. Core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2025_democracy.do imports 3497_num.csv, runs 'rename *, lower' and then 'gen item = "`var`"' over the literal list p4ju_1 p4ju_2 p4ju_3 p4ju_4 -- the IRW item code IS the source column name lowercased, nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt under the derivation rule. CHECKED ANYWAY AND DECISIVELY, without any Redivis export: applying the do-file's own filter (resp in {1,2,4,5}; 3, 8 and 9 set to missing) to the .sav reproduces the live per-item n exactly for all four items -- p4ju_1 3977 vs 3977, p4ju_2 3989 vs 3989, p4ju_3 3973 vs 3973, p4ju_4 3834 vs 3834 (live figures from irw::irw_table_sets(), server-side; total 15773 rows). The four n are mutually distinct, so this distinguishes every item from every other item. Full source cell counts, for the record: p4ju_1 1:228 2:804 3:14 4:1573 5:1372 8:10 9:9; p4ju_2 1:84 2:393 3:4 4:1571 5:1941 8:11 9:6; p4ju_3 1:146 2:608 3:9 4:1721 5:1498 8:21 9:7; p4ju_4 1:723 2:1370 3:15 4:1095 5:646 8:152 9:9. text_source=study_materials: the Spanish shipped in item_text/instructions is transcribed from CIS's own questionnaire and .sav labels. instructions is the participant-facing sentence of P.4; the trailing interviewer direction '(ENTREVISTADOR/A: LEA CADA UNO DE ELLOS Y ANOTE LA RESPUESTA)' was deliberately dropped because the schema defines instructions as the text given to the participant. translation_source=machine_translation: no English version of this questionnaire is published by CIS, so the _translated columns were produced by this project. section_prompt is blank and there is one trivial section_id; P.4 is a single flat grid with no testlet structure. RESP COVERAGE: resp=3 has no option row because it does not exist in the live table -- the processing script sets 3 (the not-read-aloud 'Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo'), 8 (N.S.) and 9 (N.C.) to missing; 42 of 16040 source cells were on code 3. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Agreement with statements about fairness and impartiality of the judicial system' matches the P.4 judiciary block exactly; no instrument mismatch. The same study supplies eight sibling IRW tables from other questions (P2/P7/P11 system, P3P parties, P3AP internal, P5ME media, P8DE efficacy, P10GR trust, P12 priorities) -- only P4JU is extracted here. RIGHTS: CIS is the rights holder and publishes the questionnaire itself; its reuse terms (https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis, fetched 2026-09-20) state only 'Esta prohibido desnaturalizar el sentido de la informacion', 'Debe citarse la fuente de los documentos objeto de la reutilizacion ... "Origen de los datos: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas"', a date-of-update mention and a no-endorsement clause, under Ley 37/2007 on re-use of public-sector information. No fee, no permission-required, no non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause appears; attribution and no-distortion reserve no right of the kind irw#1945 blocks on, so the wording ships. No instrument_rights_register.csv row written.
public_note: The response scale respondents heard was 1 Muy de acuerdo / 2 De acuerdo / 4 En desacuerdo / 5 Muy en desacuerdo, with a fifth, not-read-aloud category 3 'Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' plus 8 'N.S.' and 9 'N.C.' that the IRW processing script drops to missing, which is why resp jumps from 2 to 4 and no option row exists for 3; the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS.
